value.rationale: A diagonal triangular discontinuity is a natural non-axis-aligned stress test for Latin-hypercube integration. The exact finite-n variance across all offsets, cancellation of fractional grid phase in both first two orders, and complete arithmetic third-order cluster sets quantify a nonobvious numerical design sensitivity. This provides an attainable benchmark for uncertainty calibration/resolution comparison and is more than a generic covariance identity, trivial specialization, or isolated table lookup.
